sources.title: PyTorch 2.12 torch.cuda.memory.empty_cache
sources.paraphrase: The function releases unused allocator cache. The API documentation describes fragmentation relief as possible rather than guaranteed.

sources.title: PyTorch 2.12 CUDA semantics: Memory management
sources.paraphrase: Allocated memory tracks tensor storage; reserved memory includes the allocator pool. Cache release does not free memory occupied by live tensors.

interpretation_limit: Lower reserved memory in this local two-step fixture does not identify the cause of earlier shared-memory pressure or establish sustained throughput, long-training stability, or tracker quality.
